name: HR 5. Performance and bonus trends
rawText:
# Do you know how employee performance translates into compensation across your organization?
#  - Which departments achieve the highest average performance ratings?
#  - How many performance reviews are conducted each year?
#  - How many employees receive high performance ratings?
#  - What percentage of reviews result in high ratings?
#  - What is the average salary of employees in each department?
#  - How much bonus compensation does each department distribute?
#  - How do performance ratings and bonus distributions change over time?
#  - Which departments combine strong performance with higher bonus compensation?
# ____________________________________________________________

PerformanceReviews:
    Employee.Department.Name Department
    ReviewYear
    Count(Id) Reviews
    Avg(Rating).Round(2) AverageRating
    CountIf(Rating >= 4) HighRatings
    (CountIf(Rating >= 4) * 100.0 / Count(Id)).Round(2) HighRatingPercent
    Avg(Employee.Salary).Round(2) AverageSalary
    Sum(BonusAmount).Round(2) TotalBonus
Order ReviewYear DESC, AverageRating DESC, TotalBonus DESC
